cards.name: Guardian Angel
cards.text:
Sister Mary deck only.
Guardian Angel may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location and connecting locations.
[reaction] When any amount of damage is assigned to Guardian Angel: Add that many [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Crisis of Faith
cards.text: Revelation - For each [bless] token in the chaos bag, you must either replace it with a [curse] token or take 1 horror.

cards.name: Obscure Studies
cards.text:
Amanda Sharpe deck only.
Fast. Play when you initiate a skill test.
Return the card beneath Amanda Sharpe to your hand and place Obscure Studies beneath her.

cards.name: Whispers from the Deep
cards.text:
This skill's icons subtract from your skill value instead of adding to it.
Forced - When choosing a card to place beneath Amanda Sharpe, if Whispers from the Deep is in your hand: You must choose it.

cards.name: In the Shadows
cards.text:
Trish Scarborough deck only.
Fast. Play after your turn begins.
Disengage from each enemy engaged with you. Until the end of the round, enemies cannot engage you and you cannot deal damage to enemies.

cards.name: Shadow Agents
cards.text:
Prey - Trish Scarborough only.
Hunter.
While Shadow Agents is engaged with you, you cannot discover clues except by investigating.
Forced - After Shadow Agents is evaded: Discard it.

cards.name: Showmanship
cards.text:
Dexter Drake deck only.
[reaction] After an asset enters play under your control: Until the end of the round, you get +2 to each of your skills while resolving a triggered ability on that asset.

cards.name: Occult Scraps
cards.text:
Occult Scraps cannot be played using a play action.
While Occult Scraps is in your hand, you get -2 [willpower].
While Occult Scraps is in play, you get -1 [willpower].

cards.name: Sea Change Harpoon
cards.text:
Silas Marsh deck only.
[action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If you committed 1 or more skills to this skill test, this attack deals +1 damage. When this skill test ends, you may return Sea Change Harpoon to your hand to return all of your committed skill cards to your hand instead of discarding them.

cards.name: Silas's Net
cards.text:
Silas Marsh deck only.
[action]: Evade. You get +1 [agility] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed and you committed 1 or more skills to this skill test, you may automatically evade another enemy engaged with you. When this skill test ends, you may return Silas's Net to your hand to return all of your committed skill cards to your hand instead of discarding them.

cards.name: Siren Call
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Siren Call into play in your threat area.
As an additional cost to commit 1 or more cards to a skill test, you must pay 1 resource for each matching skill icon those cards have.
[action][action]: Discard Siren Call.

cards.name: Book of Psalms
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location. Add 2 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Blessed Blade
cards.text: [action] If Blessed Blade is ready: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If a [bless] or [elder_sign] token is revealed during this attack, this attack deals +1 damage. Before revealing chaos token(s) for this attack, you may exhaust Blessed Blade to add 1 [bless] token to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Rite of Sanctification
cards.text:
Seal (up to 5 [bless]). If Rite of Sanctification has no tokens sealed on it, discard it.
[reaction] When an investigator at your location plays a card, exhaust Rite of Sanctification and release a chaos token sealed on it: Reduce the cost of that card by 2.

cards.name: Hand of Fate
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, add [bless] tokens to the chaos bag equal to the attacking enemy's total combined damage and horror values.

cards.name: Cryptographic Cipher
cards.text:

[fast] Exhaust Cryptographic Cipher and spend 1 secret: Investigate. Your location gets +1 shroud for this investigation.
[action] Exhaust Cryptographic Cipher and spend 1 secret: Investigate. Your location gets -2 shroud for this investigation.

cards.name: Cryptic Grimoire
cards.text:
[action]: Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag.
[action] If there are 10 [curse] tokens in the chaos bag, discard Cryptic Grimoire: Record in your Campaign Log that "you have translated the grimoire." Replace 5 [curse] tokens in the chaos bag with 5 [bless] tokens.

cards.name: Deep Knowledge
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Deep Knowledge, add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.
Investigators at your location draw a combined total of 3 cards (you decide how many cards each investigator draws).

cards.name: Plan of Action
cards.text:
If this skill test is during or before the first action of this turn, Plan of Action gains [willpower] [agility].
If this skill test is between the first and third actions of this turn, draw 1 card if it succeeds.
If this skill test is during or after the third action of this turn, Plan of Action gains [combat] [intellect].

cards.name: .25 Automatic
cards.text:

cards.name: Dark Ritual
cards.text:
Seal (up to 5 [curse]).
Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: You must either spend 1 resource or discard Dark Ritual.

cards.name: Obfuscation

[reaction] When an enemy makes an attack of opportunity against you, spend 1 charge: Cancel that attack.

cards.name: Faustian Bargain
cards.text:

Investigators at your location gain a total of 5 resources, distributed as you wish.

cards.name: Sword Cane
cards.text:
Playing Sword Cane does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[reaction] After Sword Cane enters play: Immediately trigger its "[action]" ability without paying its cost.
[action] Exhaust Sword Cane: Fight/Evade. You may use your [willpower] in place of your [combat] or [agility] for this attack or evasion attempt.

cards.name: Tides of Fate
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window, or at the start of the round.
Replace all [curse] tokens in the chaos bag with an equal number of [bless] tokens. At the end of the round, replace all [bless] tokens in the chaos bag with an equal number of [curse] tokens.

cards.name: Ward of Radiance
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Reveal 5 random chaos tokens from the chaos bag. If a [bless] or [elder_sign] token is revealed, cancel that treachery card's revelation effect.

cards.name: Promise of Power
cards.text: After you commit Promise of Power to a skill test, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag. If you cannot, take 2 horror instead.

cards.name: Token of Faith
cards.text: [reaction] After a skill test ends in which 1 or more [curse] or [auto_fail] tokens were revealed, exhaust Token of Faith: Add that many [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Keep Faith
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Add 4 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Predestined
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Predestined to any type of test.
If this test fails, either add 2 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag or remove 2 [curse] tokens from the chaos bag.

cards.name: Beloved
cards.text: If a [bless] token is revealed during this test, you may remove Beloved from the game to replace that token's effects with the following: "You automatically succeed. (Do not reveal another token. Return this token to the chaos bag after this test ends)."

cards.name: Tempt Fate
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Add 3 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag. Then, add 3 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag and draw 1 card.

cards.name: Accursed Follower
cards.text:
Spawn - Location farthest from you.
Aloof.
Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Dread Curse
cards.text: Revelation - Add 5 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Day of Reckoning
cards.text:
Revelation - Attach Day of Reckoning to the current agenda. Then, search the chaos bag for an [elder_sign] token and seal it on Day of Reckoning.
Card design inspired by the events of Arkham Nights 2018.

cards.name: The Pit of Despair
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-2 instead if your location is partially flooded; -3 instead if your location is fully flooded).
[cultist]: -2. If you fail and your location is flooded, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail and you control a key, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail and The Amalgam is in the depths, put it into play engaged with you.
cards.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-3 instead if your location is partially flooded; -4 instead if your location is fully flooded).
[cultist]: -2. If your location is flooded, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -2. If you control a key, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -3. If The Amalgam is in the depths, put it into play engaged with you.

cards.name: Awakening
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.backText:
Increase the flood level of each revealed location.
Until the end of the game, each time a location is revealed, increase its flood level.
Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to agenda 2a.

cards.name: The Water Rises
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.backText:
Each revealed location becomes fully flooded.
Until the end of the game, each time a location is revealed, it becomes fully flooded.
Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder (replacing agenda 1b), and advance to agenda 3a.

cards.name: Sacrifice for the Deep
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
cards.backText: Each surviving investigator is defeated and takes 1 physical trauma.

cards.name: The Pit
cards.backText:
Spawn the set-aside The Amalgam enemy engaged with the lead investigator.
Shuffle each set-aside copy of Blindsense and From the Depths into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
Shuffle each of the set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations together to form the Tidal Tunnel deck (including the set-aside Altar to Dagon, Idol Chamber, and Sealed Exit locations). Put locations from the top of the Tidal Tunnel deck into play below, to the left, and to the right of each revealed location.
Read Flashback I in the Campaign Guide.

cards.name: The Escape
cards.text:
Forced - After a location is revealed: Put locations from the top of the Tidal Tunnel deck into play below, to the left, and to the right of that location.
Objective - There must be a way out of here somewhere. If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.

cards.name: Unfamiliar Chamber
cards.text: Forced - After Unfamiliar Chamber is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on Unfamiliar Chamber without looking at it.

cards.name: Bone-Ridden Pit
cards.text:
For each key controlled by an investigator at Bone-Ridden Pit, it gets -1 shroud.
[fast] If there are no clues on Bone-Ridden Pit and you control the yellow key: You notice an odd joint socket near the skeleton's midsection that matches the shape of the yellow key. Read Flashback II in the Campaign Guide.

cards.name: Fish Graveyard
cards.text:
Forced - After you end your turn at Fish Graveyard, if you do not control a key: Take 1 horror.
[fast] If there are no clues on Fish Graveyard and you control the red key: Inside a pile of half-rotten fish guts, you find a strange figurine the red key fits into perfectly. Read Flashback III in the Campaign Guide.

cards.name: Altar to Dagon
cards.text: [action] If investigators at Altar to Dagon control the blue key or three or more other keys, they may spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Take control of the set-aside green key.

cards.name: Idol Chamber
cards.text:
Forced - After Idol Chamber is revealed: Place the set-aside blue key on it.
[fast] If there are no clues on Idol Chamber and you control the purple key: The purple key opens the stone door at the far end of the chamber, revealing a shrine with two familiar statues, one of white marble, the other of onyx. Read Flashback IV in the Campaign Guide.

cards.name: Sealed Exit
cards.text:
[action] If an investigator at Sealed Exit controls the green key: Resign. You unlock the grate and swim through the tunnel to freedom. Return all of your clues to the token pool and place all of your keys on this location when you resign.
Forced - After Sealed Exit is revealed: It becomes fully flooded.

cards.name: The Amalgam
cards.text:
Hunter.
[reaction] After you successfully evade The Amalgam by 2 or more: Take control of 1 key on it.
Forced - After The Amalgam engages you, if you control a key: Either place 1 of your keys on it, or it attacks you.
Forced - When The Amalgam is defeated: Place it in the depths.

cards.name: Blindsense
cards.text:
Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail and The Amalgam...
- ...is in play, it readies, moves directly to your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.
- ...is in the depths, put it into play engaged with you. It makes an immediate attack.

cards.name: From the Depths
cards.text: Revelation - If The Amalgam is in the depths, put it into play engaged with you. Otherwise, place The Amalgam in the depths and From the Depths gains surge.

cards.name: The Vanishing of Elina Harper
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place 1 doom on the nearest enemy.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
cards.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the current agenda number.
[cultist]: -2. Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy (2 doom instead if you failed).
[tablet]: -3. Take 1 horror (1 horror and 1 damage instead if you failed).
[elder_thing]: -4. Place 1 of your clues on your location (2 clues instead if you failed).

cards.name: Decrepit Decay
cards.text: Forced - If you defeat a [[Suspect]] enemy other than the kidnapper: Take control of each clue on that enemy. Record in your Campaign Log (name of enemy) is out for blood.
cards.backText:
The town of Innsmouth grows more and more hostile with each day that passes. The townsfolk have caught on to your presence, and perhaps even the reason for your visit.
Shuffle the set-aside Winged One and both Hunting Nightgaunts into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
If a decision to stick together is listed under "Memories Recovered" in your Campaign Log:
After several days of investigation, you meet up with Agent Dawson to check in with him. He shows you a figurine of emerald stone depicting some sort of aquatic monstrosity, a piece of heart-shaped amber embedded in its center. After the days you have spent investigating and researching this foul place, the creature is oddly familiar to you. "I'm glad I roped you in on this case," Dawson says. "It's looking less and less like mob work with each passing hour. Let's stick together from here on out."
Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Thomas Dawson story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, he does not take up an ally slot.

cards.name: Growing Suspicion
cards.text:

(Hint: If you do not make an accusation by the time this agenda advances, you will run out of time!)

cards.name: Frantic Pursuit
cards.text: Forced - If you defeat a [[Suspect]] enemy other than the kidnapper: Take control of each clue on that enemy. Record in your Campaign Log (name of enemy) is out for blood.

cards.name: The Search for Agent Harper
cards.text:
[fast] The investigators spend X [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. Reveal the top X cards of the Leads deck (to a maximum of 3) and draw 1 of them. Shuffle the rest back into the Leads deck, along with the top card of the encounter deck. (Group limit once per round.)
Objective - You may advance at the end of any round. (Hint: You will have to make an accusation when you advance. Advance when you believe you have narrowed down Agent Harper's kidnapper and whereabouts.)
cards.backText: Read Scenario Interlude: The Accusation in the Campaign Guide.

cards.name: The Rescue
cards.text:
The kidnapper loses aloof, gets +1 [per_investigator] health, and cannot be parleyed with.
Objective - If either the kidnapper is in the victory display, or there are no clues on Elina Harper's location, advance (if there are 2 or more investigators in the game, both conditions must be fulfilled, instead).

cards.text:

Revelation - Put Shoreward Slums into play.

cards.text:

[reaction] After an enemy attacks an investigator at your location, even if that attack was canceled, exhaust Thomas Dawson: That investigator draws 1 card.

cards.name: Elina Harper
cards.text:

The first action you perform each turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.text:
Spawn - Any empty location.
Forced - When Priest of Dagon would be defeated or evaded, if there is no doom on it: Instead, heal all damage from it, ready it, and place 1 doom on it.
Forced - At the end of the round, if Priest of Dagon is ready and there is no doom on it: Place 1 doom on it.

cards.name: Initiate of Dagon
cards.text:
Spawn - Any empty location.

Forced - At the end of the round, if Initiate of Dagon is ready and there is no doom on it: Place 1 doom on it.

cards.name: Lloigor
cards.text:
Prey - Fewest cards in hand.
Aloof. Hunter.

Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each investigator at Lloigor's location or a connecting location discards 1 random card from their hand.

cards.text: Revelation - If you have no cards in your hand, Psychic Pull gains surge. Otherwise, discard 1 random card from your hand. Then, test [willpower] (X), where X is the printed cost of the discarded card. If you fail, lose 1 action.

cards.name: Deep One Bull
cards.text:
Forced - After Deep One Bull engages you: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
Forced - After an investigator defeats another [[Deep One]] enemy at any location: Ready Deep One Bull and move it once toward that investigator's location.

cards.name: Lurking Deep One
cards.text:
Prey - Lowest [agility].
Forced - After Lurking Deep One engages you: Take 1 damage.

cards.name: Deep One Assault
cards.text: Revelation - Disengage from each [[Deep One]] enemy at your location. Each [[Deep One]] enemy at your location and each connecting location engages you. If no enemies engage you from this effect, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Deep One]] enemy, spawn it engaged with you, and shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Undertow
cards.text:
Revelation - If your location is unflooded, Undertow gains surge. Otherwise, put Undertow into play in your threat area.

cards.text:

cards.text:
Lair of Dagon gets -1 shroud for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it.
[fast] Check Campaign Log. If all 7 keys are on locations and the Order's ritual was disrupted: You dig deep into your memories to recall what happened the last time you were here. Read Flashback XIV in the Campaign Guide.

cards.name: Lair of Hydra
cards.text:
Lair of Hydra gets -1 shroud for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it.
[action] Place the black, purple, or white key on this location: Deal 3 damage to an [[Ancient One]] enemy that is not slumbering. (Group limit once per game.)

cards.name: Dagon
cards.text:
Dagon is slumbering. He cannot attack or engage, and is immune to investigator actions and player card effects.
Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if an investigator is in Lair of Dagon and Dagon is ready: Place 1 doom on him.
[action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, either exhaust Dagon or remove 1 doom from him. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on him.

cards.name: Dagon
cards.text:
Hunter. Massive. Retaliate.
Dagon gets -1 fight for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it.
Forced - After Dagon is evaded or dealt damage: Do the same to a copy of Dagon's Brood in play, as well.

cards.name: Hydra
cards.text:
Hydra is slumbering. She cannot attack or engage, and is immune to investigator actions and player card effects.
Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if an investigator is in Lair of Hydra and Hydra is ready: Place 1 doom on her.
[action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, either exhaust Hydra or remove 1 doom from her. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on her.

cards.name: Hydra
cards.text:
Hunter. Massive. Retaliate.
Hydra gets -1 fight for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it.
Forced - After Hydra is evaded or dealt damage: Do the same to a copy of Hydra's Brood in play, as well.

cards.name: Aquatic Abomination
cards.text:
Hunter.
While Aquatic Abomination is moving, fully flooded locations are considered to be connected to one another.
Aquatic Abomination cannot attack during the same phase it moved via its hunter keyword.

cards.name: Dagon's Brood
cards.text:
Spawn - Lair of Dagon or Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei (whichever is farther from you).
Hunter.
Forced - After Dagon's Brood engages you, if Dagon is in play: Either place 1 doom on Dagon, or Dagon attacks you.

cards.name: Hydra's Brood
cards.text:
Spawn - Lair of Hydra or Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei (whichever is farther from you).
Hunter.
Forced - After Hydra's Brood engages you, if Hydra is in play: Either place 1 doom on Hydra, or Hydra attacks you.

cards.name: Treacherous Depths
cards.text:
Peril.
Revelation - You must either (choose one):
- Increase the flood level of your current location.
- Discard assets from your play area with a total resource cost of at least X, where X is your location's shroud value.

cards.name: Conspiracy of Deep Ones
cards.text:
Peril.
Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it. If you fail, you must either place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect may cause the current agenda to advance), or the nearest [[Ancient One]] enemy in play attacks you.

cards.name: Thalassophobia
cards.text: Revelation - If no investigators are at flooded locations, Thalassophobia gains surge. Otherwise, each investigator at a partially flooded location takes 1 horror, and each investigator at a fully flooded location takes 1 direct horror that cannot be prevented.

cards.name: Diving Suit
cards.text:
You ignore the Forced ability on the current agenda.
Forced - When any amount of damage would be placed on you: Place 1 of that damage on Diving Suit.
Forced - When Diving Suit leaves play: Remove it from the game.
